title: Mixed Event — Wonderhorror?! A Test of Courage! — Episode1 Class Representative Life

meta.Event Outline: Class representatives Emu and Mafuyu are assigned to run a voluntary weeding activity. But no one's signing up to pull weeds in the blazing summer heat! Emu thinks of a way to make it fun for the participants.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
That's all for homeroom.
Get home safe, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe!
Now that homeroom's over, I can finally go to the class rep meeting♪)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wonder what we're gonna talk about today. I really hope we start discussing school festival stuff soon!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm already getting super duper excited just thinking about it♪)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Emu!
You look more excited than usual today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have another class rep meeting?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you haven't been able to stay still since this morning. Plus, you acted the same way before your last one, so I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But is being a class rep really that fun?
It seems like a really tough job since you have to plan events and lead your classmates.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Hmm... Yeah, it can be a little tough sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm having so much fun that none of that stuff bothers me at all!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me and the other class reps think really hard about how we can make everyone smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I get really happy whenever we manage to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. You are really good at that, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, that means you gotta do your best during today's meeting! We'll be rooting for you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're supposed to meet in that classroom today... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Yikes! She's doing that thing again!
She's smiling but not smiling!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: L-Let's do our best again today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Asahina hasn't seemed like she's feeling all that great lately...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I've been seeing her more since becoming a class rep, and she always seems kinda down...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Otori?
The meeting's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh no... Thinking about too many things all at once is overloading my brain!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We're about to have the class rep meeting, so I gotta focus all my attention on that!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I need to do my best so that everyone has a fun, exciting and wonderhoy time!)
